state.brief:
Outcome: support agents resolve a ticket in 9 minutes instead of 14.
Users: tier-1 support agents.
Risk: agents distrust suggested replies.
We will create a `tickets` table with columns id, status, assignee_id and add POST /api/tickets/{id}/assign.
Introduce a TicketRouterService and a TicketRepository; the controller calls the router which calls the repository.
Users sign in with their company account. Constraint: must work with the customer's existing SSO provider.
Implement with React Query and a Redux store; poll every 5s via GET /api/notifications.
Journey: a manager opens the weekly report, filters by team, exports it and shares it with finance. Success: finance stops asking for manual spreadsheets.
Store sessions in Redis with a 30 minute TTL keyed by user id; rotate the JWT secret nightly.
Assumption: most customers have fewer than 50 users. Risk: onboarding drops if setup takes more than ten minutes. Open question: do we need an offline mode?
Change src/billing/invoice.ts to retry on failure and add an InvoiceHandler class.
Constraint: data must stay in the EU for regulatory reasons. Users call this 'the vault' and expect it to be searchable.
The mobile app should feel instant. Users complain that checkout takes too long and abandon their carts.
Add an index on orders(customer_id, created_at) and denormalise totals into a materialized view.
